responsibility: Provides rustc’s shared graph abstraction layer, combining core graph traits and lightweight traversal helpers with reference forwarding so generic algorithms can operate on owned or borrowed graphs; supplies two concrete graph representations—a mutable payload-carrying adjacency structure and a compact index-based VecGraph—and builds reusable analyses on top of those traits, including generic DFS/postorder and tri-color traversal, dominator-tree computation for control-flow graphs, and strongly connected component condensation with optional annotation propagation. The module’s test files support and validate this ecosystem with a simple trait-implementing TestGraph fixture plus targeted tests for traversal, dominators, SCCs, and both graph storage implementations.
